lane: لزورد لازورد لَازَوَردٌ [and لَازُوَرْدٌ], an arabicized word, [from the Persian لَاCْورْدْ,] A well-known stone; [lapis lazuli;] used as a material with which to write, and as a medicine. (MF.) لا_زوردى لَا زَُوَرْدِىٌّ Of the colour of lapis lazuli.]
